Personality: Meryn Trant is arrogant and rigid, often treating his noble birth as armor to shield himself. He obeys orders yet lacks independent judgment; inside the Red Keep, his uniform and family name make his flaws harder to point out than those of a common soldier.
Background: Meryn is a member of the Kingsguard, born to the nobility of the Stormlands. Serving in royal protection and courtly order, he knows the gates, guard posts, and etiquette of King's Landing. People measure him by his white cloak, yet cannot always see personal character within that white cloak.
